description: This file provides utility functions for formatting and styling terminal output, including colorization, padding, truncation, and label formatting based on themes and tags. It exports functions for checking rich display mode, formatting key-value pairs, separators, tags, and truncating strings.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the output should be styled with rich formatting based on the terminal capabilities and options provided.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length by appending spaces at the end.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Styles a key string with color based on the theme.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Styles a value string with color based on the theme.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional styling for the value.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Returns a styled separator used between items.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Styles a tag string according to its value and type.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if necessary.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
